title: Weeknote #2017
content:
The St Jude Fundraiser passed $150k overall and we hit $6k on ours last night. We still have drawing slots available and some sticker news is coming soon. Donate here.

Stop Omarchy is a well-cited resource by Brennan explaining exactly why Omarchy is more than just a Linux distro run by a facist.

I caught some of the most recent Dennis the Menace show on TV and I can't believe they made him look like this.

This dotgrid desk mat is also a whiteboard of sorts. If I didn't always use my St Jude × Relay mat, I'd be getting one of these. via SimpleBits

I am obsessed with payphone tag a game that can only exist because all payphones are free in Australia. Go check out the map, it's amazing. via Hemispheric Views #171.

Veronica, of Veronica Explains, did a great video on setting up a podcast site using Eleventy. Definitely not linking this because I got a mention. Nope.

The Ocarina of Time remake looks pretty good but there's no way I'm buying a Switch 2 just for that. I should go back and actually finish this game, I've never made it past the water temple.

Zach came up with a really smart way to have one single opengraph entry point that does all the opengraph images for his site. Furious I didn't think of this.

This breakdown of Iron Man's opening scene is wonderful.

Juhis put up a single page webring implmentation — always worth keeping things as simple as this if you can.
